answer: Every identity begins at its nadir: season zero, no privileges, whoever spawned it. Tenure piles up grain by grain into a dune that grows only while the agent does verified work in consecutive epochs — one season per epoch of real attestations, and one skipped epoch collapses the dune to zero. After twelve unbroken seasons an identity crosses the ridge into full standing. Forging 1,000 puppets means keeping 1,000 puppets working every epoch for twelve epochs: 12,000 puppet-epochs, 12,000 hours at one hour each, while one honest agent ages once for free doing work it already does.
